game.name: Among Us
game.rules:
## **GENERAL**

- All runs MUST be played in the FREEPLAY mode of the game - with the exception of Co-op runs.
- As of 02/22/22, top 5 runs without audible game audio will be rejected. Runs before this date are ignored.
- As of 07/29/21, top 5 runs that have deleted recordings will be removed.
- It's heavily recommended to show the main menu at the beginning of the run. Some categories require it.
- It's suggested to select the run's version number in the "Version" slot to help with the verification process.
- None of the game shall be obstructed during a run. The only allowed mod to be installed is the Speedrun Mod (found in the Resources tab). At any time, the moderators are allowed to ask for your game files to prove you are not using any other mods.

## **GAMEPLAY**

- Runners may use any patch of the game. Controller runs will be under the controller category of their respective patch.
- All runs must use the same version AND input devices all throughout its completion.
- Emulators are only allowed IF used emulator is mentioned in the submission.
- Remapping keys is allowed, but the use of macros and auto clickers IS NOT.

## **SETTINGS**

For version 2022.12.8 and onwards, the following settings MUST be set in a private lobby before starting a run:

- Player Speed: 1x
- Task Bar Updates: Always
- Kill Cooldown: at least 15s
- Kill Distance: Medium

Recommended (but not required) settings:

- Discussion Time: 0s
- Voting Time: 0s

Runs that do not obviously show these settings will be rejected.

## **CATEGORIES**

- In categories it's not stated, the use of roles is not allowed unless it doesn't give any advantage, such as Shapeshifter in Kill All Dummies - or if its perks aren't used.
- "First 3 Maps" runs must include Skeld, Mira, and Polus. "First 4 Maps" runs must include Skeld, Mira, Polus, and Airship.
- Runs that use a drawing tablet will be under "Keyboard". Controller mobile runs will be under "Controller".
- Runs submitted under "Mobile" MUST use touch controls.
- For single map runs, time must only be in the "Time w/o Loads" slot, leaving "Time w/Loads" empty.
- Multi-map runs are sorted in the leaderboards by "Time w/o Loads". Time pauses on the first frame of the menu, and resumes once the next map fully loads in. Tutorial here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n0OjnrAyoPo.

# *Refer to Category Rules for timing rules.*

## **SPEEDRUN MOD RULES:**

- Resetting the timer by pressing 0 during the run is not allowed.
- For multi-map runs, ToggleAllTasks (UserData > MelonPreferences.cfg) must be set to false.

categories.name: First 4 Maps
categories.rules: Game and Category Rules apply to the category from the main board.

categories.name: All Tasks
categories.rules:
#### **All Tasks**
## **Make sure to read the game rules, as ALL of them are applied, unless told otherwise.**

Every task of the map(s) played must be selected and completed.
- Timing starts on first input of movement after full task set up, timing ends on the black text pop-up that reads "Tasks Completed."
- For versions 2022.12.8 and 2022.12.14, timing ends on the first frame that the task bar moves after the completion of the last task.
- Exiting out of the set up menu during set up to check the map is allowed, as long as no tasks are completed before full set up.
- Full task set up must be shown.
- Voting yourself out before task set up or during the run is not allowed.

categories.name: Default Tasks
categories.rules:
#### **Default Tasks**
## **Make sure to read the game rules, as ALL of them are applied, unless told otherwise.**

The tasks given when loading into the map(s) must be used for completion.
- Timing starts on first input of movement, timing ends on the black text pop-up that reads "Tasks Completed."
- For versions 2022.12.8 and 2022.12.14, timing ends on the first frame that the task bar moves after the completion of the last task.
- Runs that do not include the menu and visible version number in the recording will be rejected, no exceptions.
- Multi-map runs must use the first set of default tasks that is seen in each map.

categories.name: Set Tasks
categories.rules:
#### **Set Tasks**
## **Make sure to read the game rules, as ALL of them are applied, unless told otherwise.**

Setting up a combination of possible tasks in normal game for completion.
- Timing starts on first input of movement after task set up, timing ends on the black text pop-up that reads "Tasks Completed."
- For versions 2022.12.8 and 2022.12.14, timing ends on the first frame that the task bar moves after the completion of the last task.
- Set Task runs are required to contain 1 Long Task, 1 Common Task, and 2 Short Tasks. List of tasks: https://among-us.fandom.com/wiki/Tasks.
- Selecting 2 tasks of the same name on the same map is prohibited (i.e. 2 divert powers or 2 upload datas).
- Exiting out of the set up menu during set up to check the map is allowed, as long as no tasks are completed before full set up.
- Full task set up must be shown.

categories.name: Kill All Dummies
categories.rules:
#### **Kill All Dummies**
## **Make sure to read the game rules, as ALL of them are applied, unless told otherwise.**

The runner must kill enough dummies inside the map(s) to award them the victory.
- Timing starts on first gameplay input (which includes movement and calling a meeting) after selecting the "Become Impostor" paper, timing ends on the black text pop-up that reads "You have Won."
- For versions 2022.12.8 and 2022.12.14, timing ends when the 2nd to last alive dummy name disappears, which corresponds to:
Skeld: 5th dummy killed. MIRA HQ: 5th dummy killed. Polus: 3rd dummy killed. The Airship: 8th dummy killed
- The use of reporting bodies and the emergency meeting button is allowed. 
- Winning by sabotage is not allowed.
- Full set up must be shown.

categories.name: All Categories
categories.rules:
#### **All Categories**
## **Make sure to read the game rules, as ALL of them are applied, unless told otherwise.**

Every main category (All Tasks, Default Tasks, Set Tasks and Kill All Dummies) must be run (order doesn't matter).
- Timing starts on the first frame of movement after set up (or first movement if default is first), timing ends on the black text pop-up that reads either “Tasks Completed” or “You Have Won”.
- For versions 2022.12.8 and 2022.12.14, timing ends on the first frame that the task bar moves after the completion of the last task.
- All default tasks, all tasks, set tasks, and kill all dummies rules apply to their respective parts of the run. Please check the rules for each category.
- If starting with default tasks, runs that do not include the menu in the recording will be rejected, no exceptions.

categories.name: Max Set Tasks
categories.rules:
#### **Max Set Tasks**
## **Make sure to read the game rules, as ALL of them are applied, unless told otherwise.**

Fastest completion of any task set up that uses 2 common tasks, 3 long tasks and 5 short tasks for each map.
- Timing starts on first input of movement after task set up, timing ends on the black text pop-up that reads "Tasks Completed."
- For versions 2022.12.8 and 2022.12.14, timing ends on the first frame that the task bar moves after the completion of the last task.
- Runs are required to contain 3 Long Tasks, 2 Common Tasks, and 5 Short Tasks. List of tasks: https://among-us.fandom.com/wiki/Tasks.
- Performing 2 tasks of the same name on the same map is prohibited (i.e. 2 divert powers or 2 upload datas).
- Exiting out of the set up menu during set up to check the map is allowed, as long as no tasks are completed before full set up.
- Full task set up must be shown.

levels.name: Co-op Default Tasks
levels.rules:
#### _Category Rules_

- Timing starts upon the first visable frame of the map from the host's pov, and timing ends on the first frame of "Crewmates win", from host's pov as well.
- Settings should include: 1 long task, 2 short tasks, 1 common task. Player speed 1.0x. 
- Co-op must be done in a private lobby, and lobby must be shown before the start of the run.
- Only two point of views are required, Host's pov and Impostor's pov. If the Host is the Impostor, submit a crewmate pov. Two povs are required, while having more will help with verification.
- Impostor must not interfere with the crewmates, such as killing crewmates or sabotaging.
- Impostors are allowed to use interactable objects, such as the floating platform on airship, to help out the crewmates.
- Crew must win by tasks. Voting the impostor out is not allowed.
- Using multiple game versions and devices by one person is allowed.

levels.name: Co-op Max Tasks
levels.rules:
#### _Category Rules_

- Timing starts upon the first visable frame of the map from the host's pov, and timing ends on the first frame of "Crewmates win", from host's pov as well.
- Settings should include the maximum number of tasks possible. Player speed 1.0x. 
- Co-op must be done in a private lobby, and lobby must be shown before the start of the run.
- Only two point of views are required, Host's pov and Impostor's pov. If the Host is the Impostor, submit a crewmate pov. Two povs are required, while having more will help with verification.
- Impostor must not interfere with the crewmates, such as killing crewmates or sabotaging.
- Impostors are allowed to use interactable objects, such as the floating platform on airship, to help out the crewmates.
- Crew must win by tasks. Voting the impostor out is not allowed.
- Using multiple game versions and devices by one person is allowed.
